profile.org_note: Small single-company structure (about 140 staff per a Aug 2026 company post): CEO Kevin Egan and President/COO Paul Miller run it from Lewisville, with one land head (Forrest Hartley) buying all homesites in both states and CFO/Treasurer Todd Friant on finance. Two Colorado division offices (Loveland, Colorado Springs). Owner-side Bright family members (Parker and Justin Bright) and Bright Realty's Eric Stanley sit on the officer list, so capital decisions likely involve the parent.
profile.summary: Family- and employee-owned DFW builder (founded 2003, Bright Industries family; ESOP since 2017) with Colorado Front Range divisions since 2018; Builder 100 2026 rank 87. Buys finished lots in third-party master-planned communities (Hillwood's Treeline, Ramble and Landmark; Mustang Lakes, Ten Mile Creek, Sterling Ranch, RainDance, Barefoot Lakes) plus the family's own Castle Hills. Land is bought by one executive, Forrest Hartley, which makes him the single point of contact for a land banker.

people.name: Forrest Hartley
people.title: Vice President; Land Acquisition Manager
people.source_title: Texas Comptroller franchise-tax public record, American Legend Homes, LLC (2026 report year officers)
people.note: Officer title 'Vice President' on the 2026 Texas franchise-tax report. The company's Dec 2022 release names him Land Acquisition Manager since 2011, part of the executive team, evaluating master-planned communities and overseeing purchase of all homesites in DFW and Colorado (https://www.amlegendhomes.com/blog/american-legend-homes-announces-new-ceo-and-leadership-team). A 2026 company blog post calls him 'Land Manager'. The single land head for both states; primary land-banking contact. Reporting line not stated. Email built from the alhltd.com pattern on the contact page, not published for him. Title note: Purchases all homesites in DFW and Colorado.

Current as of 2026: the 2026 Texas franchise-tax report lists him as 'VP, Sec. and Treasurer' of American Legend Homes, LLC, Belclaire Homes, LLC and American Legend Homes Brokerage, LLC (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/account-status/search/32035740177). Title note: VP, Secretary and Treasurer is the title on the franchise-tax filing.
